title: Paneer Butter Masala
subtitle: Stovetop Version
headnote: Draft: The source lists 2 tablespoons of cream but uses only 1 tablespoon in the directions. Confirm the intended amount. This stovetop version uses a different sauce and method from the pressure-cooker version.

ingredientGroups.title: To finish
items: 1½ tsp ginger-garlic paste (½ inch ginger and 3 medium garlic cloves)
200–250 g paneer, cubed and soaked in hot water for 20 minutes
½–¾ tsp dried kasuri methi, or ½–¾ Tbsp fresh minced fenugreek leaves

steps: Heat the oil with 2 cardamom pods. Add the onions and sauté until soft and translucent.
Add the tomatoes and salt; fry for 3 minutes, then cover and cook until soft.
Add the garam masala, coriander, cashews, chili powder and sugar. Fry until aromatic and the mixture pulls away from the sides.
Cool completely, then purée with 1 cup water until smooth.
Heat the butter with the cinnamon, cloves, remaining cardamom and bay leaf for 1–2 minutes.
Sauté the ginger-garlic paste over low heat until softened, without burning. Add the purée and ¼ tsp chili powder.
Reduce the heat to its lowest setting and add the paneer and ½ tsp kasuri methi. Garnish with 1 Tbsp cream and the cilantro.
reviewFlags: The source lists 2 Tbsp cream but uses 1 Tbsp in the method.
